| # Self-monitoring overview {#self-monitoring-overview-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                         |                                                                                                                                             |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

RCs feature a sophisticated monitoring concept to detect defects in the RCs HW. The corresponding SW functions are integrated into the BSW to monitor the hardware in the background.

By default this monitor is continuously active. If the monitoring detects any difference from normal hardware operation an error reaction is processed.  

oAfter power-Up dedicated [startup monitor checks](startup-monitoring.html){.topiclink} are done, e.g., Shut-OFF path test.

oLater [cyclic hardware monitoring checks](cyclic-monitoring-checks.html){.topiclink} are executured in parallel to the running application, e.g.,Cyclic RAM Checks.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.
